sentences.text: Gobipipus is a genus of enantiornithine bird, a group within the class Reptilia.

The only known fossil is an incomplete embryo discovered by a Russian-Mongolian expedition in the Barun Goyot Formation of the Gobi Desert. Kurochkin, Chatterjee, and Mikhailov described the genus in 2013, naming the type species Gobipipus reshetovi.
This animal lived from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
